text:
mara: quick follow-up from RFC: we still see p99 spikes when tiny chat bursts co-exist with long-streaming requests. noticed a pattern of small gaps piling up.
ken: yep. fragmentation looks like the root cause rather than pure eviction churn.
yusuf: did anyone try a micro-pad per GPU? small best-effort slot for <=24 tokens to fill gaps?
mara: i ran a short staging test: pad reduced p99 by ~15% but raised token/sec cost ~3%.
anya: tradeoff sounds reasonable if we gate by tenant tier. free tenants can be best-effort, paid get preferential packing.
ken: also curious about oscillation when tenants auto-resize slot sizes. we need smoothing (alpha) and a min-stable-interval.
yusuf: propose alpha=0.18 and min_interval=30s. prevents rapid switches.
mara: okay. another idea: lane profiles (small/medium/large) with an overflow shared lane. avoids one tenant blowing up global packing.
anya: overflow lane must be lower priority and not touch KV-cache allocation for long contexts.
ken: eviction semantics: immediate eviction causes visible tail jumps. suggest "graceful-evict": mark for eviction, allow N tokens or T ms then evict. config per-tenant.
yusuf: implement metric tags so extra tokens during graceful-evict are billable and attributed.
mara: ops-bot: can we deploy pad+graceful-evict to staging canary?
ops-bot: deploy: pad-pool + graceful-evict feature branch rolled to staging (group beta). Smoke OK.
anya: monitoring queries: fragmentation_ratio = 1 - (sum(allocatable_bytes)/sum(total_bytes)) by lane. watch pad_fill_ratio too.
ken: action items: 1) pad soft-cap + LIFO eviction (yusuf), 2) slot-smoothing params + min-interval (ken), 3) graceful-evict billing tags (mara), 4) dashboard tiles (anya). 1-week spike?
mara: i'll add to sprint and open PRs. close for now. :lock:
